question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Components'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the given sentence, Living and non-living things form the** (2) ____**of our surroundings, we need an appropriate word from the given options which will convey the same context.
 
• In the given context, **Components** refer to one of several parts of which something is made. 
 
 
• **​Example: **Enriched uranium is a key** component **of a nuclear weapon.
 
 

​Therefore, the most appropriate word to be filled in the blank is** 'component'.**

Hence, the correct answer is **option 3.**
